title: FedRAN: Accurate and Efficient Analytic Federated Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.11480v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Federated continual learning (FCL) enables distributed clients to learn from evolving data streams while retaining knowledge from previously observed tasks. Existing optimization-based FCL methods often rely on repeated local training, incurring communication overhead and feature drift across clients. Analytic alternatives avoid iterative training, but high-dimensional random features used to improve accuracy require communicating a Gram matrix whose cost grows quadratically with feature dimension. Communication-efficient alternatives reduce this cost by statistically reconstructing the Gram matrix from first-order summaries. We propose FedRAN, a low-rank analytic FCL framework that instead compresses the required second-order structure directly through spectral summaries that are merged across clients and tasks. translated_title: FedRAN：准确且高效的分析式联邦持续学习
translated_abstract: 联邦持续学习（FCL）使分布式客户端能够从不断演进的数据流中学习，同时保留先前所学任务的知识。现有的基于优化的FCL方法通常依赖重复的本地训练，会带来通信开销以及客户端之间的特征漂移。分析式方法虽然避免了迭代训练，但用于提升精度的高维随机特征需要传输一个Gram矩阵，其通信成本随特征维度呈二次方增长。通信高效的替代方案通过从一阶统计量统计重建Gram矩阵来降低这一成本。我们提出了FedRAN，一个低秩分析式FCL框架，它通过跨客户端与任务合并的谱摘要直接压缩所需的二阶结构。所保留的秩显式地控制了近似精度与通信之间的权衡，有效降低了二阶结构的通信成本（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: FedRAN提出了一种低秩分析式联邦持续学习框架，通过跨客户端与任务合并的谱摘要直接压缩二阶结构，并利用保留的秩显式控制近似精度与通信开销之间的权衡，实现准确且高效的联邦持续学习。
en_tdlr: FedRAN is a low-rank analytic federated continual learning framework that compresses the required second-order structure through spectral summaries merged across clients and tasks, with the retained rank explicitly controlling the tradeoff between approximation fidelity and communication cost.
